generatedFull.method: ChatGPT image edit using the original full-resolution scene as the authoritative target and each H3-extracted frame as a mouth/lower-jaw pose reference

usage: generated-full/ retains the approved editable full-scene sources. Runtime mouth layers are stored in runtimeDirectory.
note: closed/open are exact source composites, while release/small-open/half-open are ChatGPT-generated edits. Extracted H3 frames, review copies, and intermediate lower-face crops were removed after approval.
